description: This script initializes and manages an SQLite database for the medical_prescription_database project. It includes functions to determine the database path, ensure backward compatibility by adding missing columns, run migrations, and generate configuration files for database visualization and developer reference.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Returns the path to the SQLite database file using the SQLITE_DB environment variable or defaults to 'myapp.db'.

methods.name: None write_connection_info(db_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a file 'db_connection.txt' containing connection instructions for developers and containers.

methods.name: None write_visualizer_env(db_path: str)
methods.description: Generates or updates 'db_visualizer/sqlite.env' with the absolute database path for use in Node.js database viewers.

methods.name: None ensure_users_public_id_column(db_path: str)
methods.description: Checks if the 'public_id' column exists in 'users' table, adds it if missing, and creates an index for it. Ensures backward compatibility with older schemas.

methods.name: None run_migrations()
methods.description: Calls the 'migrate' function from 'db_migrate' to perform SQL database migrations.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Executes the initialization sequence: resolves DB path, ensures schema compatibility, runs migrations, and generates configuration files. Also outputs status messages and timestamp.
